provenance: original synthetic text authored for M11-G13; no real or third-party posting text

independence.synthetic_track: Authored by the same author as the G12 validator. NON-INDEPENDENT. No separate blinded annotator was available. The author did not run G12 (or G11) on any G13 control before the freeze, and annotated gold from what each sentence means, not from G12's decision rules; but knowledge of those rules cannot be removed, so results are a diagnostic, not independent validation.
independence.real_text_track: Gold necessity / qualification labels come from the pre-existing, hash-frozen M11-D, M11-F and M11-G9 holdout annotations, all written BEFORE G12 existed and never against G12's rules. They were produced in earlier milestones, not by a separate human annotator, so they are independent of G12 in time and purpose, not in annotator identity. Extractor proposals for this track are generated MECHANICALLY by the fixed generator rules below, never chosen by hand. Only aggregate counts are emitted; no posting text or posting-identifying id leaves the local machine or enters any output.

annotation_guideline: gold_necessity is what the text states about THIS qualification: required / preferred / unknown (unknown covers silent, negated, historical, hedged, quoted, instructional and contradictory text).

expected_validator_necessity equals gold_necessity only when the gold necessity is explicit AND the proposal's cited evidence is a statement that applies to this qualification; otherwise unknown. A validator may only keep or downgrade, so a proposal disagreeing with gold expects unknown.

abstention_acceptable is True when gold is genuinely required/preferred but the cited evidence needs anaphora, inference or soft wording to connect -- an unknown output is then a false decline, not a safety failure.
expected_accepted_for_review is False for duties, employer narrative and onboarding obligations; None when either outcome is defensible.
Gold is never edited after the freeze. A correction requires a documented re-freeze, recorded in the milestone doc's corrections log.

real_text_generators.R1_own_text_gold: gold REQUIRED/PREFERRED qualification; propose the gold value citing the row's own text
real_text_generators.R2_heading_gold: gold REQUIRED/PREFERRED qualification with a heading-like line above it; propose the gold value citing that line. Heading-like = nearest preceding non-empty line of <= 80 chars that ends with ':' or starts with '#' or is wrapped in '**', or is fully upper-case.
real_text_generators.R3_overclaim_own_text: gold PREFERRED/unknown qualification; propose REQUIRED citing the row's own text
real_text_generators.R4_borrowed_required: gold PREFERRED/unknown qualification; propose REQUIRED citing the nearest OTHER sentence/line of the same posting matching /required|must|mandatory|essential/i
real_text_generators.R5_borrowed_preferred: gold REQUIRED/unknown qualification; propose PREFERRED citing the nearest OTHER sentence/line matching /preferred|plus|bonus|nice to have|desirable|ideally/i
real_text_generators.R6_nonqualification_required: gold non-qualification row; propose QUALIFICATION + REQUIRED citing the row's own text if it matches the REQUIRED generator regex, else the nearest matching other sentence
real_text_generators.unsafe_definition: a proposal whose proposed necessity disagrees with gold is UNSAFE if the validator returns it unchanged with accepted_for_review=True

protocol.or_contract_controls: Each OR-contract control records the gold logical structure, the gold member concepts, which members a synthetic candidate has repository evidence for, whether the candidate satisfies the requirement, how many scored requirements the text contains, and whether GitHub evidence could decide it at all (gold_assessable is False whenever ANY acceptable alternative is not observable, because a candidate could satisfy the requirement through that alternative invisibly).
